work.description: Brief CL beatifies Martin de Porres, Dominican tertiary of Lima, with office and Mass for Lima and the Dominican order; LF32172 → LF32182 across own provenance LF32175, signature LF32176 and page number 218 LF32179; LF32242 → LF32248 across running title LF32245; LF32309 → LF32315 across running title LF32312; LF32377 → LF32383 across page number 219 LF32380; 8 August 1837 dating clause with the seal and subscription Loco > signi / Pro dom. card. De Grecorio / A. Picchioni substitutus (LF32401–32407), retained. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF32120–32120; the source closing at LF32395–32407 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio- rem sub annulo piscatoris die octava augusti millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo septimo , pontificatus, Nostri anno septimo. Loco > signi Pro dom. card. De Grecorio A. Picchioni substitutus.
